description: Defines playable story scripts: the row ID and Script asset name used to locate and load the script, the BGM request, and an optional Map row whose level list story phases use for transitions.

ID.simple: Row key / script ID used to look up the script row (export label ID; native property Id).
ID.technical: FName primary key (native Id at row +0x08; DataTable ImportKeyField=Id). All 245 exported rows have a unique key equal to the exported ID value. UGamePhase_StoryDemoBase::PreparePhase walks ScriptDataTables for GetScriptId() and caches the first matching row in ScriptRow; Story_GetScriptLevels_1307AE0 and Story_FindScriptRow use the same key (the latter rejects NAME_None and checks the row struct before the first match). GetScriptId is virtual: pre-/post-battle phases take StoryDemo.Id_Script_PreBattle/Id_Script_PostBattle, the collection phase synthesizes GALLERY_01..04 and the short-story phase uses the short-story row id. The ID, not ScriptFileName, is tested against the hard-coded credit list (STDM_05065B, STDM_08094A, STDM_09114A) and movie list (STDM_08090A, STDM_08094A, STDM_09095A, STDM_09114A), selecting extra widgets; story-demo prepare dereferences the found row unguarded.

ScriptFileName.simple: Primary asset name of the script data asset to load (equals ID in the export).
ScriptFileName.technical: FName (row +0x10). Story-demo prepare passes it to UGameScriptPlayer::SetScript, which stores FPrimaryAssetId("Script", ScriptFileName); UpdateLoad uses that ID to load and cache UGameScriptData from /Game/Scripts, initialize the context, derive message ids and voice cue sheets, and add related thumbnails. The shipped config declares PrimaryAssetType "Script" for /Game/Scripts. GameScript_IsDlcScript scans every Script row for a matching ScriptFileName, then requires a StoryDemo row whose Id_Script_PreBattle or Id_Script_PostBattle equals that name and whose chapter has a first UserProgressFlag != -1; it selects the DLC voice tables in ParseVoice and the DLC voice-cue path in UpdateLoad. All 245 exported rows have ScriptFileName == row key, but 52 rows are not named by any exported StoryDemo pre/post field, so they fail this second DLC condition. Voice branching also tests the name's GALLERY_/STDM_SS_ substrings before the DLC test.

Id_Bgm.simple: BGM ID requested when the story-demo phase prepares.
Id_Bgm.technical: FName (row +0x18). With a valid Script row, NAME_None calls StopBgm(0.0f) (immediate fade-out); otherwise PlayBgm(Id_Bgm, 0.0f, 0.5f, true) passes the value to the BGM loader as the cue name, with 0 s start time, a 0.5 s fade in/out and looping enabled. Retail reads the field unguarded. In the export, STDM_09104B and STDM_09111B use the None sentinel; the other 243 rows use 15 distinct BGMDataTable IDs (BGM_DEMO_01 alone appears on 123 rows), all of which exist in BgmDataTable.

Id_Map.simple: Optional Map row ID supplying a story phase's level list.
Id_Map.technical: FName (row +0x20). Story_GetScriptLevels_1307AE0 resolves the Script row by ID, then Status_FindMapRow(MapDataTables, Id_Map, true, false); NAME_None is rejected up front, and an empty TArray is returned if either lookup fails. On success it returns Map.FileName (export label Filename), including any None placeholders. Unlike StoryMission.Id_Map / Story_GetMissionMapId, Script.Id_Map has no random-map fallback. The levels feed battle-story, credits, collection, main-menu story, script and story-character-select phase transitions; StoryDemoBase::StudioPhaseQuery2D0 filters None entries and only defers to the base query when no non-None level remains. Only 8/245 exported rows set this field: GALLERY_01..04 -> SDM_10..40 and STDM_01000A/STDM_04054B/STDM_05065B/STDM_06085B -> SDM_10/SDM_20/SDM_30/SDM_40; all four map rows exist and each Filename begins with the matching SDM level plus an _Environment level and two None slots.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_Script derives from FTableRowBase; Id, ScriptFileName, Id_Bgm and Id_Map are all BlueprintReadWrite/EditAnywhere FName properties. The constructor is empty, so every field defaults to FName()/NAME_None (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_Script.cpp:3).

The export set contains one unlocalized, unsharded ScriptDataTable asset (245 rows, ImportKeyField=Id, RowStruct=GameDataTableRow_Script). No numbered ScriptDataTable shards or locale variants were found; ScriptCharacterDataTable and ScriptCharacterClothesDataTable use different row structs and are not shards of this table.

GameDataTableManager adds the loaded ScriptDataTable asset to the ScriptDataTables array (DTM +0xA50) after all DataTable loaders complete. All script finders walk that array in order and take the first match; StoryFindRow/StoryFindRowInlineChecked reject NAME_None and filter by row struct, while StoryDemoBase's direct FindRow loop does not add those checks. Story_FindScriptRow is exported from StoryLaunchHelpers but has no C++ caller in the reconstructed source.

NAME_None is the unset sentinel, not a row reference: 237/245 rows leave Id_Map unset and two leave Id_Bgm unset. The four SDM_ map rows each supply ['SDM_xx', 'SDM_xx_Environment', 'None', 'None'] in Filename; callers such as StudioPhaseQuery2D0 filter the None entries.

ScriptFileName is also an alias source: the DLC decision needs a matching StoryDemo pre-/post-battle script name plus a progress-flag chapter, and voice/thumbnail loading uses the loaded script asset's message ids and related StoryDemo rows rather than the Script row's other fields.

Runtime context is reconstructed C++ and shipped config with retail RVAs noted in comments; no retail Blueprint graph evidence was available, so exhaustive Blueprint or asset-level usage beyond these traced paths is not claimed.

usages.detail: Resolves the loaded ScriptDataTable primary asset into ScriptDataTables (DTM +0xA50) after loaders complete.
Prepare state 0 looks up GetScriptId(), then reads Id_Bgm, ScriptFileName and Id for BGM, script loading and credit/movie widget selection; the ScriptRow is dereferenced unguarded.
SetScript converts ScriptFileName into FPrimaryAssetId("Script", ScriptFileName); UpdateLoad loads/caches UGameScriptData and the derived message, voice and thumbnail assets.
Story_GetScriptLevels_1307AE0 resolves Id_Map through MapDataTables and returns Map.FileName, or an empty list when either row is absent.
StudioPhaseQuery2D0 filters None level names from that list and only uses the base query when no usable level remains.
GameScript_IsDlcScript matches ScriptFileName, follows StoryDemo pre/post-battle aliases and checks chapter progress; ParseVoice then chooses DLC vs normal voice rows.
Story_FindScriptRow exposes the row-struct-filtered, None-rejecting first-table lookup for ScriptId; no C++ caller was found in the reconstruction.
The shipped AssetManager config registers PrimaryAssetType "Script" for /Game/Scripts, the target of ScriptFileName.
